QuestInfo.name: [Retro World] Eliminate the Demon King
QuestInfo.0: An evil king is said to reside in the mysterious tower that appeared on the outskirts of Balina in Retro World. Many champions have challenged the tower, but none have beaten the king. If you think you can succeed where they failed, this is your chance.
